about.en: USDhl is a dollar stablecoin built for the Hyperliquid ecosystem, described by its issuer as a fiat stable custom-built for the Hyperliquid ecosystem and a building block for HIP-3, FX and payments. It is powered by M0 and circulates both as a HIP-1 token on the Hyperliquid L1 and as an ERC-20 on HyperEVM.
